title: AI-Powered Smart Grid: Revolutionizing Electricity Distribution and Generation
description: Artificial intelligence is already being used in smart grids for demand forecasting, grid balancing, fault detection, and renewable integration.
short_description: A clear guide to demand forecasting, grid balancing, renewables, and the awkward bit where energy theory meets field reality.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in Smart Grid for grid operators, infrastructure planners, policy teams, and readers tracking energy systems.
